history.summary: Uncompleted freehold 2BR (775sqft) at a very steep $2,581 PSF / ~$2.0M in D12 Balestier, TOP 2028, 1.09km from Toa Payoh MRT. Full new-launch CCR-fringe pricing on a small 2BR with no transaction history, weak walkability, and a quantum at the top of the 2BR band.
history.rating_rationale: Pays full new-launch developer pricing ($2,581 PSF, ~$2.0M for a 775sqft 2BR) without the location to justify it — 1.09km/13-min from Toa Payoh MRT is poor for a transit-led rental thesis, and TOP 2028 means no occupancy/yield for years plus exposure to lease-up-period supply. Freehold is the only structural plus. At this PSF a 5-7yr resale needs strong D12 appreciation just to clear costs; risk/reward is poor.
red_flags: $2,581 PSF — full new-launch pricing on a small 2BR
TOP 2028 — no rental income for years, construction/completion risk
1.09km from Toa Payoh MRT — weak walkability
$2.0M quantum at the top of the 2BR band; no URA data
catalysts: Brand-new build appeals to own-stay segment on resale
